name: Adam Kraft
notes: Founder of Fake and Gay (2018 queer pop event series, SF with offshoots in Portland, Seattle, and NYC). Curated Boiler Room events, shaped stages at Outside Lands and Portola. Shared bills with SOPHIE, Skrillex, Honey Dijon, Azealia Banks, AG Cook, Tokischa, Sara Landry. Released 'program presents: Adam Kraft (DJ Mix)' (Apple Music, 2024).
